# ModAssets <Badge type="info" text="class" />

<p class="api-meta">Namespace <code>Lustral</code> · Assembly <code>Lustral.Api</code></p>

Loads Unity asset bundles shipped with a mod, on both Mono and IL2CPP:

```csharp
var bundle = Assets.LoadBundle("Assets/ui.bundle");
var panel = bundle.Load<GameObject>("Panel");
```

This also works in IL2CPP games whose builds do not include Unity's `AssetBundle` class, because Lustral calls the engine directly. Bundles must be loaded on the main thread, from [`Mod.OnGameReady`](/api/mod#ongameready) onward.

```csharp
public sealed class ModAssets
```

## Remarks

Build bundles with the game's Unity version or a close version; Unity cannot load bundles built with a newer version. Ship bundles in the mod's folder (`<None Include="Assets\**" CopyToOutputDirectory="PreserveNewest" />` in the project file), or embed them in the mod's assembly and load them from bytes.

## Methods

### LoadBundle(string) {#loadbundle-string}

```csharp
public ModAssetBundle LoadBundle(string path);
```

Loads an asset bundle file. Relative paths are resolved against the mod's folder ([`ModInfo.Directory`](/api/mod-info#directory)). Loading a file that is already loaded returns the same bundle, because Unity loads each bundle only once.

**Exceptions**

- [`FileNotFoundException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.io.filenotfoundexception): The file does not exist.
- [`InvalidOperationException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.invalidoperationexception): Unity could not load the bundle (the game's log, `Player.log`, contains the reason), or the method was called before the game was ready or outside the main thread.

### LoadBundle(byte[]) {#loadbundle-byte-array}

```csharp
public ModAssetBundle LoadBundle(byte[] data);
```

Loads an asset bundle from memory, such as a bundle embedded in the mod's assembly: `Assets.LoadBundle(ReadResource("MyMod.ui.bundle"))`.

**Exceptions**

- [`InvalidOperationException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.invalidoperationexception): Unity could not load the bundle (the game's log, `Player.log`, contains the reason), or the method was called before the game was ready or outside the main thread.
